Month.label: Month of Observation
Month.description: Calendar month (1 = Jan, ..., 7 = July monsoon peak, 12 = Dec).

Rainfall.label: Monthly Precipitation
Rainfall.description: Total monthly rainfall recorded at the meteorological station.

Cloud_Coverage.label: Cloud Coverage
Cloud_Coverage.description: Cloud cover in eighths of the celestial dome (0 = clear sky, 8 = completely overcast).

Bright_Sunshine.label: Bright Sunshine Duration
Bright_Sunshine.description: Daily average sunshine hours (decreases sharply during stormy or monsoon conditions).

ALT.label: Station Altitude / Elevation
ALT.description: Topographical elevation above sea level (low-lying flatlands face higher inundation risk).

Wind_Speed.label: Average Wind Speed
Wind_Speed.description: Average wind speed recorded at the monitoring station.

dataset_name: Historical Flood & Meteorological Records (Gauhar et al., IEEE 2021)
